def test_monotonic_ids():
    v = View()
    i1 = v.begin("q1")
    i2 = v.begin("q2")
    i3 = v.begin("q3")

from view import View


def test_basic_flow():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading is False
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) is False
    r1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert r1 == 1
    assert v.loading is True
    assert v.finish(1, [1, 2]) is True
    assert v.rows == [1, 2]
    assert v.loading is False
    # duplicate finish
    assert v.finish(1, [9]) is False
    assert v.rows == [1, 2]


def test_stale_reply():
    v = View()
    assert v.begin('q1') == 1
    assert v.begin('q2') == 2
    assert v.loading is True
    # older request id must be rejected
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) is False
    # latest may finish
    assert v.finish(2, [2]) is True
    assert v.rows == [2]


def test_query_arg_preserved_and_rows_copied():
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin('important')
    assert v.loading is True
    rows = [object()]
    assert v.finish(id1, rows) is True
    copied = v.rows
    assert copied == rows
    assert copied is not rows
    assert v.rows[0] is not rows[0]
    assert v.loading is False


def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.notes = {'a': 'note', 'b': 'other'}
    assert v.begin('q') == 1
    assert v.finish(1, [1]) is True
    assert v.notes == {'a': 'note', 'b': 'other'}
    # next request keeps notes
    assert v.begin('q2') == 2
    assert v.notes == {'a': 'note', 'b': 'other'}
    assert v.finish(2, [2]) is True
    assert v.notes == {'a': 'note', 'b': 'other'}


def test_begin_keeps_rows_and_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.begin('q1')
    assert v.finish(1, [10]) is True
    assert v.rows == [10]
    v.error = 'boom'
    assert v.begin('q2') == 2
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.finish(2, [20]) is True
    assert v.rows == [20]


def test_sequential_requests():
    v = View()
    ids = [v.begin(str(i)) for i in range(10)]
    assert ids == list(range(1, 11))
    assert v.finish(10, [100]) is True
    assert v.rows == [100]
    for i in range(1, 10):

    # rows only updated by latest
